verdict.rationale: Fern is an SDK generator and documentation platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis, but the evidence never documents an isolated sandbox for testing against non-production data. The local preview server only previews documentation changes before publishing. That is a dry-run preview of content, not a sandbox, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Run a local preview server to view documentation changes instantly with hot reload.
